title: H4cker panel v4
features:
🧩 User Interface System
Modern rounded UI design with neon-green hacker theme
Fully draggable panel (smooth, no glitch dragging)
Fixed open / close button (always accessible, never disappears)
Scrollable tab bar with left–right sliding for extra tabs
Smooth tab switching system (no overlap, no ghost frames)
Center-top animated notifications (slide down & auto-dismiss)
📜 Executor Tab
Built-in Lua executor
Supports:
loadstring
Local client scripts
Run button executes instantly
Execution logs are sent to Console tab
🖥 Console Tab
Live execution logs
Displays:
Script executions
System actions
Panel events
Clean terminal-style text layout
📦 Script Hub Tab
Includes multiple built-in scripts, not just ESP:
ESP (Pro Version)
Speed Boost
Jump Power
FOV Warp
Fake Ban Screen
Reset FOV
More expandable buttons supported
Each script:
Runs locally
Logs to console
Can be disabled safely
👁 ESP System (Improved)
Box ESP (stable, optimized)
Distance display (updates live)
Team-based coloring
If no team → defaults to White
Head-based tracking
Always-on-top rendering
Toggleable from Settings
Proper cleanup when disabled (no stuck visuals)
⚙ Settings Tab
Disable ESP (full cleanup, including distance text)
Future-ready system (easy to add toggles & sliders)
Console feedback on every action
📝 Changelog Tab
Displays:
Version updates
Feature additions
Fixes & improvements
Text aligned top-left
Clean readable font size
Styled like Credits (no oversized text)
👤 Credits Tab
Simple, clean text
Normal font size (not too big, not too small)
Displays:
Made by Roy Aich
Must Subscribe
🔒 Safety & Stability
LocalScript only
No ServerScript required
No screen shake
No blind effects
No forced teleport or fly
Clean enable/disable systems
No UI freezing or tab locking
🚀 Version Focus (V4)
Stability first
UI polish
Proper tab system
Expandable script hub
Cleaner ESP implementation
No broken features carried over
